findings: Candidate commit bc8b35f4f02af6e76819736b60872b03d72dce93 (tree 678b59a139e7130ad4d668e3998a0909fb2b8bdf) over base dac00001652b5c4a6297de1d3a8747f743432dfa adds only the 9 expected paths (crates/mori-core/tests/program_ir_contract.rs, 6 frozen oracle payloads, FREEZE.sha256, and README.md) with zero production or dependency changes and preserves prior freezes including 7a314c14b87bb48e7ba26cc4f85096d0a5e860e8c0310d216c2437947a3ecc5b.

All 6 frozen oracle members (DERIVATION.md, INVENTORY.json, counter.mori, counter.program.expected.json, empty-frame.mori, empty-frame.program.expected.json) and FREEZE.sha256 (c1b5027d0cab397134337d4346e2c956fffde532d4a9e56843b725df212cba99) in candidate/crates/fixtures/program-ir-contract/ are exact byte-identical copies of independent-oracles/, derived from public DTOs/docs/literals before test author consumption without reading or running parser or runtime implementations.

Both test functions in crates/mori-core/tests/program_ir_contract.rs (SHA-256 5b359d34bb404c2b35a6bdd53374aaf4db65910b104f17cf9a13290dd390a2db, rustfmt-clean) invoke public mori_core::parse on the embedded .mori fixtures and compare the complete serialized Program via serde_json::to_value against the decoded frozen JSON oracle without field filtering, projection, normalization, or actual-to-expected generation, exposing all 7 Program fields (language, semantics, name, states, assets, expressions, actions).

Static trace of mori_core::parse confirms exact semantic and structural correspondence: Counter produces all 11 expression nodes in lexical/postorder (0..10) and 5 statements referencing roots 2, 5, 6, 9, 10 with count state initializer kept in StateDecl.initial; PreservedIdleFrame retains its two states (count=5, ready=true), CASH asset (scale 2), empty idle action, uninvoked declare action with Liability statement referencing amount ExprId 0, and sole global Literal UInt 0 expression node.

PROPOSAL.json specifies a single new substantive resource allocation (attemptLimit 1, 60s wall + 5s kill grace, --frozen, -j1, --test-threads=1, owned cold target, owned fresh CARGO_HOME with only registry/git symlinks, strict 13-env whitelist with no HOME, 4 verified tool SHA-256 pins, and 14 ancestor Cargo config absence checks) selecting -p mori-core --no-default-features --test program_ir_contract, which excludes midnight-compat-tests/SDK/CLI/compiler/network paths.
limitations: Actual parser calls and test execution remain UNRUN in this read-only source and command-eligibility review; result verification requires post-execution audit of the single approved run.

Correspondence is scoped to the two finite positive normal Core/1 Program fixtures (Counter and PreservedIdleFrame) under declared source-order/fresh-node/postorder representation premises, and does not establish general frontend, compiler, simulate-output, or native target proofs.
Oracle derivation is post-adoption and exposed to public DTOs and adopted report documentation rather than pre-implementation blinded.
Security review is performed by the designated Gemini fallback reviewer following the documented Opus 4.8 rate-limit outage.
